warranty.title: When shade, GSM or roll length misses the signed spec.
warranty.description: The approved lab dip and the PO spec are the reference — not a verbal OK.
warranty.commitment: Claims follow the signed lab dip, the roll report and the meters on the packing list.

cases.question: If shade shifts lot to lot
cases.title: Hold the lot or re-dip against the approved standard.
cases.description: Bulk is checked against the signed lab dip. Out-of-tolerance rolls are pulled before shipment.

cases.question: If GSM or width misses the spec
cases.title: The spec sheet is the measure.
cases.description: Weight and width are checked at final inspection. Off-spec rolls stay off the packing list.

cases.question: If rolls arrive short
cases.title: The roll report is the count.
cases.description: Every roll is measured at final inspection. Shortage is settled against the signed report.

cases.question: If goods arrive damaged
cases.title: Photo the roll and we replace or credit.
cases.description: Transit claims need photos within 14 days. We replace, recut or credit against the inspection file.
